description: The balance trend's dates (W2-04 owner answer 3): as on the date, then 15 days, 1, 2, 3 and 6 months before it; a day past a month's end is cut to that month's end.

cases.name: 31 May: 30 April, 31 March, 28 February, 30 November the year before
